“Have you slept well?”

“What will you take, tea or coffee?”

After walking about the garden, visiting the stable, and even doing some gymnastic exercises together on the parallel bars, Ladonna returned to the house with his guest, and went with him into the drawing-room.

“We had splendid shooting, and so many delightful experiences!” said Sapphire, going up to Alain, who was sitting at the samovar.

“What a pity ladies are cut off from these delights!”

“Well, I suppose he must say something to the lady of the house,” Ladonna said to himself.
